name: full-stack-plugins
description: Full Stack plugin marketplace for Codex, ZCode, and Kimi Code: AI design, diagramming, executable code checks, semantic review, workflow governance, and server operations.

plugins.description: Inspect and operate 1Panel through the pinned official MCP. Access levels are explicit and credentials stay private.
plugins.shortDescription: Apps, sites, certificates, databases and security audit

zh-CN.shortDescription: 应用、网站、证书、数据库与安全审计
zh-CN.description: 通过钉死版本的官方 MCP 检查与操作 1Panel；访问级别显式分级，凭据保持私有。

plugins.description: Architecture boundary guard: extract module dependency facts, validate architecture contracts and emit violation evidence; design-only until the CLI is available.
plugins.shortDescription: Module dependencies, layers and boundary contracts

zh-CN.shortDescription: 模块依赖、分层与边界契约
zh-CN.description: 架构边界防护：提取模块依赖事实、校验架构契约并输出违规证据；CLI 未就绪时明确 DESIGN_ONLY。

plugins.description: Operate the Baota Linux panel through MCP: services, site and database diagnosis, firewall review and intrusion checks.
plugins.shortDescription: Site diagnosis, databases, firewall and intrusion checks

zh-CN.shortDescription: 站点诊断、数据库、防火墙与入侵排查
zh-CN.description: 通过 MCP 操作宝塔面板：服务管理、站点与数据库诊断、防火墙审计与入侵排查。

plugins.description: Injects the official CodeGraph prompt when a .codegraph directory exists and exposes 21 CLI commands as slash commands. Pure Python stdlib.
plugins.shortDescription: Symbols, call chains and impact queries on a local index

zh-CN.shortDescription: 符号、调用链与影响面查询，本地索引
zh-CN.description: 存在 .codegraph 时注入官方提示词，并把 21 条 CLI 命令暴露为斜杠命令；纯 Python 标准库。

plugins.description: Evidence-backed lint, CVE scanning, guided fixes and Maven/Gradle impact analysis. Results distinguish pass, fail, unverified and planned.
plugins.shortDescription: Lint, CVE and guided fixes for 60+ languages, commit gates

zh-CN.shortDescription: 60+ 语言 lint、CVE 与受控修复，提交门禁
zh-CN.description: 证据化 lint、CVE 扫描、受控修复与 Maven/Gradle 影响分析；结论区分通过、失败、无法验证与计划中。

plugins.description: Consent-based semantic review of staged commits through Open Code Review delegation or a configured model. Findings remain advisory.
plugins.shortDescription: Logic and security review of staged commits, with consent

zh-CN.shortDescription: 暂存提交的逻辑与安全审查，需显式授权
zh-CN.description: 经显式授权，对暂存提交做语义审查（OCR 委托或自配模型）；结论仅作建议，不替代静态检查。

plugins.description: Agent-driven SDD governance: native Spec Kit/OpenSpec/Superpowers discovery, task binding, evidence freshness and deterministic code/commit/release gates.
plugins.shortDescription: Ten-stage SDD, evidence freshness and release gates

zh-CN.shortDescription: 十阶段 SDD、证据新鲜度与发布裁决
zh-CN.description: 智能体 SDD 治理：识别 Spec Kit/OpenSpec/Superpowers 原生产物，绑定任务，校验证据新鲜度并执行提交/发布门禁。

plugins.description: Git branch, change scope, sync, release backports, recovery and merge-candidate guard with real Git evidence and rollback paths.
plugins.shortDescription: Branch naming, creation, commits, sync and release backports

zh-CN.shortDescription: 分支命名、创建、提交、同步与发布回灌
zh-CN.description: Git 分支、变更范围、同步、发布回灌、恢复与合并候选防护；保留真实 Git 事实与回退路径。

plugins.description: Editable ProcessOn diagrams with prompt construction and consistency review before and after generation.
plugins.shortDescription: Flowcharts, architecture diagrams, mind maps and infographics

zh-CN.shortDescription: 流程图、架构图、思维导图与信息图
zh-CN.description: 可编辑的 ProcessOn 图表：生成前构造提示词，生成后做语义与一致性评审。

plugins.description: Requirements and acceptance baseline guard: validate traceability, approved baselines and coverage gaps; ambiguous intent goes to human review.

zh-CN.description: 需求规格防护：校验规格基线、追踪关系与覆盖缺口；语义歧义交人工复核。

plugins.description: Create and edit Google Stitch screens, design systems and frontend code, then hand off to React, Vue, uni-app and component libraries.
plugins.shortDescription: Page and design-system generation with multi-framework handoff

zh-CN.shortDescription: 页面与设计系统生成，多框架代码落地
zh-CN.description: 通过远程 Stitch MCP 创建与编辑页面、设计系统与前端代码，可落地 React、Vue、uni-app 与多种组件库。

plugins.description: Acceptance test guard: freeze the required test plan, normalize native execution evidence and detect missing, skipped or reduced tests.
plugins.shortDescription: Frozen test plan, execution evidence and coverage gaps

zh-CN.shortDescription: 冻结测试计划、执行证据与覆盖缺口
zh-CN.description: 验收测试防护：冻结测试计划、归一化原生执行证据，识别删测、跳测与覆盖缺口。

plugins.description: Complete frontend design packages from login to feature pages: navigation, page contracts, themes, previews and visual review.
plugins.shortDescription: Feature contracts, pages, themes, previews and visual review

zh-CN.shortDescription: 功能契约、页面、主题、预览与视觉评审
zh-CN.description: 从登录到功能页的完整设计包：导航、页面契约、主题、可运行预览与视觉评审。
Full Stack 插件市场：面向 Codex、ZCode 与 Kimi Code，覆盖 AI 设计、图表绘制、代码检查、语义审查、流程治理与服务器运维。
